description: Grants the player 5 food when completing a set of 6 Character cards of different types. The effect does not apply to eventual sets completed before obtaining this card
Grants the player a discount of 1 food per Farmers in their tribe during Sustainment event
Grants the player a discount of 1 food per Artist in their tribe during Sustainment event
Grants the player immunity to malus during Ritual event
Grants the player 1 additional food when placing totem on slot of OrderCard with a food bonus at the end of their turn
Grants the player 3 food when obtaining two Inventors with the same icon. The effect does not apply to eventual couples obtained before this card
Grants the player double prestige points when winning Ritual event without sharing victory with another player
Grants the player 3 extra ritual stars
Grants the player a discount of 1 food per Inventor in their tribe during Sustainment event
Grants the player 1 extra Food and Prestige Points per Hunter in their Tribe during Hunt Events
Grants the player Double the Prestige Points granted by the Builder cards in their Tribe
Grants the player 1 Food per Artist in their Tribe during Painting Events
Grants the player 6 Prestige Points per set of Six Different Role Characters in your Tribe in EndGame
Grants the player 3 Prestige Points per Hunter in their Tribe in EndGame
Grants the player 4 Prestige Points per Farmer in their Tribe in EndGame
Grants the player 4 Prestige Points per Shaman in their Tribe in EndGame
Grants the player 4 Prestige Points per Builder in their Tribe in EndGame
Grants the player 4 Prestige Points per Artist in their Tribe in EndGame
Grants the player 2 Prestige Points per Inventor in their Tribe in EndGame
Grants the player an extra draw from the UpperRow, at the end of everyone's the action phase
Grants the player a flat 25 Prestige Points in EndGame
